audit_items.proof_trace: The if/else guard in `unsafe_repay_debt_only` splits on `ceil(debt.amount) <= amount`: the true branch calls `cleared()` setting debt to exactly zero; the false branch (where `ceil(debt.amount) > amount`) mathematically guarantees `debt.amount.value > from(amount).value` (proven: `ceil(x) > n` implies `x.value > n*WAD`), so `unsafe_decrease` via `float::sub` cannot underflow. Both repay and liquidation paths accrue interest before calling this function, and `unsafe_decrease` has no other callers.
